reports.title: Richard Sanders: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: The BDSG has created, and is continuing to compile a pack for use at an incident to help preserve evidence: BDSG Serious Accident Guide for Divers v1.
promises.summary: Create a guide to preserve diving incident evidence

promises.quote: We will continue with these and similar activities in future.
promises.summary: Continue research, education, and awareness activities on IPO.

concerns.quote: Whether there is sufficient awareness of the risks & affects of immersion pulmonary oedema by those engaged &/ or participating in the activity of diving

Whether sufficient consideration has been given to the requirement for a "fitness to Gloucestershire Coroner's Court, Corinium Avenue, Barnwood, Gloucester, GL4 3DJ dive" medical certificate as a prerequisite to participation in diving activities.
concerns.hazard: lack of fitness to dive medical certificate requirement

concerns.quote: Whether more efficient methods and/ techniques of diver removal from the water could be employed at the diving centre

reports.title: Kevin Lapwood: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: I am concerned about the level of training and awareness nationally - specifically of the medical requirements for volunteers involved in projects like Kevin was.
concerns.hazard: lack of training and awareness of medical requirements for volunteers

concerns.quote: I am concerned about the level of training and awareness around the risks of immersion pulmonary oedema('IPO') for divers with high blood pressure. Whilst the more common risks of hypertension will be better understood (such as heart attack and stroke), awareness of IPO appears to be less well understood.
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness of immersion pulmonary oedema risk for divers with high blood pressure

concerns.quote: I am concerned about whether there is sufficient guidance regarding what the role of shore support /surface cover entails. Specifically, should that include having eyes on the water?
concerns.hazard: uncertainty about shore support/surface cover responsibilities

concerns.quote: The title of the document - does this document adequately reflect that it also covers volunteers? Is there a risk that, on reading the initial heading of the document, it may be felt that it is not relevant to volunteers working in the capacity that Kevin did?
concerns.hazard: ambiguous document title causing potential exclusion of volunteers

concerns.quote: Would the reference to "associated guidance" on the title page be better with the use of a hyperlink to guidance such as the volunteer diver guidance note?
concerns.hazard: lack of direct access to associated guidance

concerns.quote: The definition of "diver" in the ACOP is "a person at work who dives". The definition of "at work" is (in summary) an employee or a self-employed person. Although the guidance does go on to deal separately with those in a diving role as part of a project, there is some potential ambiguity here.
concerns.hazard: ambiguous definition of "diver" limiting regulatory applicability

concerns.quote: All the titles of the relevant legislation and guidance refer to diving "at work". It is easily foreseeable that someone looking at this may assume that is not relevant for volunteers used as part of a diving project.
concerns.hazard: legislation titles creating perception of exclusion of volunteers

concerns.quote: I am concerned that there is currently no requirement for doctors conducting HSE medicals to confirm that they have advised patients who fail the HSE medical, for reasons similar to those in Kevin's case, of the risks of IPO.
concerns.hazard: lack of mandatory risk communication by doctors conducting HSE medicals
